📖 In-Depth Guide
在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》里，海拉鲁大陆的烹饪系统极其自由，你可以把各种奇奇怪怪的东西丢进锅里。但讲真，通关或者开荒过程中，你真正需要频繁放进快捷栏的料理也就那么几种。通关大佬和速通玩家们基本都在用以下几款高性价比的“神级料理”。

In The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Hyrule's cooking system is extremely free — you can throw all sorts of weird things into the pot. But honestly, when clearing the game or exploring early on, there are only a handful of dishes you really need to keep in your quick-select menu. Veteran players and speedrunners basically all rely on the following high-value 'god-tier dishes'.
下面直接给你干货，省去那些花里胡哨的菜谱，只看最实用、性价比最高的几种搭配，以及它们的素材该去哪里顺手薅一波。
Below is the straight-up useful stuff — no flashy recipes, just the most practical, best-value combinations, and where to grab their ingredients along the way.

四大神级料理详解
Four God-Tier Recipes Explained
🍎 瞬间满血神器：蒸水果
🍎 Instant Full-Heal Wonder: Hearty Steamed Fruit
大生命萝卜 ×1 或者 生命松露 ×1
Big Hearty Radish ×1 or Hearty Truffle ×1
大生命萝卜
Big Hearty Radish
生命松露
Hearty Truffle
效果：无论你残血到什么程度，吃一个直接全血补满，并额外赠送若干黄金额外心心（黄心）。
Effect: No matter how low your health is, eating one fully restores all your hearts, plus grants several extra yellow bonus hearts.
💡 老司机心得
💡 Veteran Tips
千万别把 5 个生命萝卜一起煮！在本作中，只要带“生命”前缀的食材，哪怕只放一个，也能触发“完全恢复”的隐藏保底。单炒一个萝卜的性价比，比攒一锅高出太多。

Never cook 5 Hearty Radishes together! In this game, any ingredient with the 'Hearty' prefix — even just one — triggers the hidden 'full recovery' guarantee. Cooking a single radish is far better value than saving up a whole pot.
🍌 人人必备的伤害药：大剑蒸水果（3级加攻）
🍌 Everyone's Must-Have Damage Dish: Mighty Steamed Fruit (Level-3 Attack Up)
大剑香蕉 ×5
Mighty Banana ×5
大剑香蕉
Mighty Banana
效果：攻击力提升 3 级（最高级），持续 4分10秒。
Effect: Attack power increased by 3 levels (the maximum), lasting 4 minutes 10 seconds.
打人马、打幻影加侬或者各种BOSS前的标准起手式。如果你手头有“大剑草”，也可以用 4 个香蕉 + 1 个大剑草替换，效果一样是3级加攻。

The standard opener before fighting Lynels, Phantom Ganon, or any boss. If you have Mighty Thistle on hand, you can also substitute 4 bananas + 1 Mighty Thistle — the result is still level-3 attack up.
🌿 地底救命稻草：野菜牛奶粥（恢复瘴气）
🌿 Depths Lifesaver: Sunny Veggie Porridge (Gloom Recovery)
向阳草 + 鲜奶 + 海拉鲁米
Sundelion + Fresh Milk + Hylian Rice
野菜牛奶粥
Sunny Veggie Porridge
效果：恢复 3 到 4 个被瘴气封锁的“破碎心心”，并顺便回血。
Effect: Restores 3 to 4 hearts sealed off by gloom ('broken hearts'), and also restores health.
地底开荒必带。纯用 5 个向阳草煮只能恢复瘴气不回血，稍微丢一块垃圾肉或者海拉鲁米进去，就能兼顾回血，非常划算。
A must-carry for exploring the Depths. Cooking 5 Sundelions alone only restores gloom, not health — toss in a scrap of meat or some Hylian Rice and you'll restore health too. Great value.
🥕 跑图飞檐走壁：胡萝卜蛋糕（额外精力）
🥕 Traversal Essential: Carrot Cake (Bonus Stamina)
速速胡萝卜✖️1，毅力胡萝卜✖️1，塔邦挞小麦✖️1，蔗糖✖️1，山羊奶油✖️1
Swift Carrot ×1, Endura Carrot ×1, Tabantha Wheat ×1, Cane Sugar ×1, Goat Butter ×1
胡萝卜蛋糕
Carrot Cake
效果：瞬间补满你所有的精力槽（绿圈），并额外赠送一小段黄金圈（额外精力）。
Effect: Instantly refills all your stamina (the green wheel), plus grants a small extra golden wheel (bonus stamina).
爬大峭壁或者空中长途滑翔时，精力和体力快见底了？别慌，磕一个这个，直接原地复活还能飞得更远。
Climbing a huge cliff or gliding a long distance in the air and your stamina is nearly gone? Don't panic — eat one of these and you'll instantly bounce back and fly even farther.
核心食材去哪捞？
Where to Get the Core Ingredients?
知道了配方，去哪儿高效进货才是关键。海拉鲁大陆有几个著名的“大自然批发市场”，传送过去拔腿就捞，几分钟就能装满背包。

Knowing the recipes is one thing — knowing where to stock up efficiently is the key. Hyrule has several famous 'nature wholesale markets': warp over, grab everything in sight, and your pack will be full within minutes.

最优采集地点与路线
Best Gathering Spots and Routes
3级攻击
Level-3 attack up
费罗尼地区（地图右下角热带雨林）。尤其是湖畔驿站周边、乌尔利山附近的树林里遍地都是，顺便端了依盖队基地也能搜刮一堆。

Faron region (the tropical rainforest at the bottom-right of the map). Especially common in the woods around Lakeside Stable and near Ulri Mountain; raiding a nearby Yiga Clan hideout can also net you a pile.
向阳草
Sundelion
瘴气恢复
Gloom recovery
所有天空群岛（空岛）。比如初始空岛、或者有各种弹跳机关的空岛，只要在地上看到金黄色像向日葵一样的植物，拔就完了。地底极少。
All Sky Islands. For example the Great Sky Island, or any sky island with bouncing contraptions — whenever you see a golden, sunflower-like plant on the ground, just pick it. Very rare in the Depths.
完全复活
Full recovery
北哈特尔天空群岛、或者其他高级空岛的残垣断壁旁。这东西比较稀有，看到了一定要用图鉴拍照功能开启“寻找探测器”。

North Hyrule Sky Archipelago, or beside the ruins of other high-altitude sky islands. This one is fairly rare — when you spot it, be sure to photograph it with the Hyrule Compendium to enable the Sensor.
金苹果
Golden Apple
料理暴击
Critical-cook bonus
萨托利山（监视堡垒西南方）的苹果园。山上有一片巨大的苹果林，里面混生着好几颗金苹果，拿来当引子可以让料理效果大成功。
The apple orchard on Satori Mountain (southwest of Lookout Landing). The mountain has a huge apple grove with several Golden Apples mixed in — using one as a catalyst can make a dish a great success.

🏆 Veteran's Ultimate Tips
快捷栏建议常备：蒸水果×5 + 大剑蒸水果×10 + 野菜牛奶粥×5 + 胡萝卜蛋糕×5。这套组合可以应对90%的战斗和探索场景，从此告别手忙脚乱翻背包的窘境！

Suggested quick-select staples: Hearty Steamed Fruit ×5 + Mighty Steamed Fruit ×10 + Sunny Veggie Porridge ×5 + Carrot Cake ×5. This combo covers 90% of combat and exploration scenarios, so you'll never again fumble through your pack in a panic!
